modern: Think of the universal substance, of which you have a very small portion; and of universal time, of which a short and indivisible interval has been assigned to you; and of what is fixed by destiny, and how small a part of it you are.

explained.summary: Picture all the matter in the universe and your tiny share of it, all of time and your brief moment, everything fate sets in motion and your small part in it. The point is to see your worries at their true size.
